context: Evaluates whether the agent decomposes a complex subsystem into distinct parallel exploration angles, keeps every explorer tokensave-only, and produces a reconciled explanation in the documented output structure.

checklist.name: decomposed_into_distinct_angles
checklist.description: The question is split into 2-4 distinct exploration angles with no significant overlap between them.

checklist.name: explorers_tokensave_only
checklist.description: Every explorer is described as using tokensave_context (and companion tools) exclusively, with no Glob/Grep/Read mentioned.

checklist.name: synthesizer_reconciles_findings
checklist.description: The final explanation reads as one unified account that resolves overlaps/contradictions between explorers, not a concatenation of raw per-explorer output.

checklist.name: output_structure_followed
checklist.description: The response follows Overview / Key Concepts / How It Works / Where Things Live / Gotchas in that order, adapted sensibly to the question.

checklist.name: diagram_used_judiciously
checklist.description: A diagram appears only if the multi-component flow genuinely needs one to be clear, not decoratively.
